title: App Store previews, hybrid: the header's world around the real build-284 recordings
brief: Three App Previews (iPhone 6.9"/6.5", 886 × 1920, 15–30 s, 30 fps, silent) in the App Store header's world (ads/app-store-header-all: A, B3, C2 subtle): Emma's real photos with depth, garments lifting and gliding with soft shadows, S-V3's subtle blue (the linen ground, ink over slate navy, cool slate shadows; no warm tone), the camera glide, the lockup; and in the phone, at the centre of almost every frame, the real build-284 recording. 1 Your closet (her photo gives up the camel coat; the real scan) · 2 See it on you (the black tee; Studio's real Try it on) · 3 What to wear (a rail of days lands on Today; the real Today and Zee chat). The screen-recording cuts (ads/app-store-previews) are kept as versions.
hook: Frame 0: her photo (or the rail of days) in the tonal set with the phone already standing in it, the app moving; inside 1.5 s a garment lifts out of her photo with depth and a soft shadow and glides to the phone, and the camera pushes into the app by 4 s.
